I would like to discuss:

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11365

and

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11360

PR[ #297](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/297) proposes standardizing default JWT secret paths so EL and CL clients can auto-discover shared secrets without users manually specifying --jwt-secret flags. The spec has been open since 2022 with input from Geth, Nethermind, Teku, and Nimbus, but we need explicit buy-in from all CL teams (Lighthouse, Prysm, Lodestar, Grandine etc ) on whether they're willing to implement default path searching and if MUST or SHOULD is appropriate for compliance. We're asking each client team to review the PR and share their position on feasibility and any blockers.

Regarding the variable payload deadline, I've summarized some thoughts in a blog post and would like to quickly talk about it:
https://hackmd.io/@Nerolation/B1GKtAUcZg

We should talk about the problems with the EIP-4788 system contract that came up in the epbs channel:
https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1483594736043429999

We would like to share and present in ACDC  [EIP-8148: Custom sweep threshold for validators](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148), authored by Lido contributors  @dgusakov, @madlabman and @gkoumout .

Can we SFI all bal-devnet-2 EIPs into Amsterdam? **Note** I won't make the call but would like to push for this!

PR with more context: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11399

We discussed this on ACDT this week, but didn't want to make a decision outside of ACDE/ACDC.

> We would like to share and present in ACDC  [EIP-8148: Custom sweep threshold for validators](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8148), authored by Lido contributors  @dgusakov, @madlabman and @gkoumout .


Thanks for sharing. Liquidity issues are the #1 reason for slow 0x02 adoption, see: https://x.com/efprotocol/status/2020861054809424245?s=46&t=x0SpNy0nEL2Z0UTvB4MJUw
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
